historical_references.reference: The Prophet Muhammad named a well 'Aaseman' in Medina after seeing a vision of a man with the same name who had provided him water during his night journey to Jerusalem.
historical_references.context: Islamic tradition, Hadith, Sahih Bukhari, Volume 1, Book 8, Number 387

historical_references.reference: Aaseman was also the name of a famous companion of the Prophet Muhammad, Asma bint Abu Bakr As-Siddiq, who was known for her exceptional generosity and piety.
